claims.claim: The Cascade regional blood centre operates a mobile collection drive at its Portland site.
The drive collects at a measured average of 12 usable units per hour while it is open.
The drive is open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM America/Los_Angeles.
The collection week under consideration runs Monday 20 July to Friday 24 July 2026.
The centre held 40 usable units in stock at 9:00 AM on Monday 20 July 2026.
St. Vincent regional hospital held 15 usable units at the same moment.
The centre ships its available stock to St. Vincent every Tuesday and Thursday at 4:00 PM America/Los_Angeles.
A shipment takes about 3 hours to reach the hospital and be received into its bank.
claims.source: Courier service level and prior receipts

claims.claim: The Tuesday and Thursday shipments each move 150 units, the capacity of the centre's transport cooler.
Bank supervisor Elena Cruz oversees receipts at the hospital but does not control the collection rate or the shipping schedule.
